info.title: Chainlink ACE Reporting API
info.description: Read-only API for querying onchain state, transaction history, policy configurations, identities, and credentials

get.description: Retrieve a list of policies. Returns state as of the specified time.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Show policies active as of given time (ISO 8601 format). Returns historical state.

parameters.name: policy_engine_address
parameters.description: Filter by policy engine address

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Filter by owner address

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Filter by chain selector (uint64)

parameters.name: include_policy_details
parameters.description: Include policy state JSON in the response

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for pagination

get.summary: Get policy by chain and address
get.description: Retrieve a specific policy by its chain selector and address at a given point in time. Returns the policy version that was active at the specified as_of time.

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Chain selector where the policy is deployed

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Policy contract address

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Show policy state as of given time (ISO 8601 format). Returns historical state.

parameters.name: include_policy_details
parameters.description: Include policy state JSON in the response

get.description: Retrieve a specific version of a policy (version can be numeric or "latest")

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Chain selector where the policy is deployed

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Policy contract address

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version number or "latest"

get.description:
Retrieve a list of identities with various filters.
- Filter by wallet address to find which identity owns it
- Filter by identity registry to see all identities in a registry
- Filter by credential type to find identities with specific credentials
- Filter by credential registry to see identities with credentials from that registry

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Show identities active as of given time (ISO 8601 format). Returns historical state.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Filter by wallet address (find identity that owns this address)

parameters.name: identity_registry
parameters.description: Filter by identity registry address

parameters.name: credential_registry
parameters.description: Filter by credential registry address (find identities with credentials from this registry)

parameters.name: credential_type_id
parameters.description: Filter by credential type ID (find identities with this credential type)

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Filter by chain selector

parameters.name: include_credential_details
parameters.description: Include full credential data for each identity

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for pagination

get.description:
Retrieve a specific identity by its Cross-Chain ID (CCID).
Returns the full identity with all registries, addresses, and optionally credentials.

parameters.name: ccid
parameters.description: Cross-Chain ID (CCID) - 66 character hex string

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Show identity state as of given time (ISO 8601 format). Returns historical state.

parameters.name: include_credential_details
parameters.description: Include full credential data

get.description:
Retrieve a list of targets (contracts protected by policy engines).
- Filter by policy engine address to see targets attached to a specific engine
- Filter by chain selector to see targets on a specific chain
- Use include_policy_details to get full policy configuration for each target

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Show targets active as of given time (ISO 8601 format). Returns historical state.

parameters.name: policy_engine_address
parameters.description: Filter by policy engine address

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Filter by chain selector

parameters.name: include_policy_details
parameters.description: Include policy state JSON in the response

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for pagination

get.summary: Get target by chain and address
get.description:
Retrieve a specific target by its chain selector and address.
Returns the target with all policy engine attachments and their configurations.

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Chain selector where the target is deployed

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Target contract address

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Show target state as of given time (ISO 8601 format). Returns historical state.

parameters.name: include_policy_details
parameters.description: Include policy state JSON in the response

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of transactions that triggered at least one
ACE policy engine evaluation (PolicyRunComplete event). Only transactions
belonging to the caller's organization are returned. Setup-only
transactions (e.g. IdentityRegistered) that did not produce a policy
run are excluded.

Sort contract:
- `sort` must include both `chain_selector` and `block_number` (comma-separated)
- Only `block_number` supports a direction prefix (`-` for descending, `+` or no prefix for ascending)
- Valid values: `chain_selector,block_number`, `chain_selector,-block_number`
- Default: `chain_selector,-block_number` (newest first within each chain)

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Filter by chain selector

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on block_timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on block_timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

parameters.name: from_address
parameters.description: Filter by sender address

parameters.name: to_address
parameters.description: Filter by recipient address

parameters.name: target_contract_address
parameters.description: Filter by target contract address (contract must be integrated with ACE)

parameters.name: function_selector
parameters.description: Filter by function selector (4-byte hex, e.g. 0xa9059cbb)

parameters.name: policy_address
parameters.description: Filter by policy contract address that evaluated the transaction

parameters.name: policy_engine_address
parameters.description: Filter by policy engine address that evaluated the transaction

parameters.name: include_policy_details
parameters.description: Include policy state JSON in the response

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort order for results. Must include both chain_selector and block_number (comma-separated).
Only block_number supports a direction prefix (- for descending, + or no prefix for ascending).
Valid values: chain_selector,block_number or chain_selector,-block_number.
Default: chain_selector,-block_number

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for pagination

get.description:
Paginated list of stored on-chain permits. Only permits for policies
belonging to the caller's organization are returned.

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Filter by chain selector

parameters.name: policy_address
parameters.description: Filter by policy contract address that stored the permit

parameters.name: permit_id
parameters.description: Filter by permit ID (lowercase 0x-prefixed bytes32)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on block_timestamp (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on block_timestamp (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort order. Must include both chain_selector and block_number (comma-separated).
Only block_number supports a direction prefix (- for descending, + or no prefix for ascending).
Valid values: chain_selector,block_number or chain_selector,-block_number.
Default: chain_selector,-block_number

404.description: Policy not found for the caller on this chain, when policy_address is set

get.description:
Paginated list of proven registry usage. The caller must own the requested registry for the given chain.

Sort contract (same as /transactions):
- `sort` must include both `chain_selector` and `block_number` (comma-separated)
- Only `block_number` supports a direction prefix (`-` for descending, `+` or no prefix for ascending)
- Valid values: `chain_selector,block_number`, `chain_selector,-block_number`
- Default: `chain_selector,-block_number`

parameters.name: registry_type
parameters.description: Whether the caller's registry filter is a credential or identity registry address

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Chain selector where the registry and runs are evaluated

parameters.name: registry_address
parameters.description: Registry contract address owned by the caller for this chain

parameters.name: ccid
parameters.description: Optional filter — only return rows for this CCID (lowercase 0x-prefixed bytes32)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on policy run block_timestamp (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on policy run block_timestamp (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort order. Must include both chain_selector and block_number (comma-separated).
Only block_number supports a direction prefix (- for descending, + or no prefix for ascending).
Valid values: chain_selector,block_number or chain_selector,-block_number.
Default: chain_selector,-block_number

404.description: Registry not found for the caller on this chain, or not owned by the caller

get.summary: Get transaction by chain selector and hash
get.description:
Retrieve a specific transaction by its chain selector and transaction hash.
The transaction must have triggered at least one ACE policy engine
evaluation (PolicyRunComplete event) within the caller's organization;
otherwise a 404 is returned. Setup-only transactions
(e.g. IdentityRegistered) are not accessible through this endpoint.

parameters.name: chain_selector
parameters.description: Chain selector where the transaction was executed

parameters.name: tx_hash
parameters.description: Transaction hash

parameters.name: include_policy_details
parameters.description: Include policy state JSON in the response

404.description: Transaction not found or has no policy engine evaluations in this organization

Blockhash.description: Block hash (0x followed by 64 hex characters)

Bytes32.description: 32-byte hex string (0x followed by 64 hex characters)

ChainSelector.description: Chain selector represented as a string to avoid JavaScript number precision loss (values can exceed 2^53). The underlying type is uint64.

credential_type_id.description: Type identifier for this credential (e.g., KYC_VERIFIED, ACCREDITED_INVESTOR)

credential_registry.description: The credential registry that issued this credential

expires_at.description: When this credential expires (null if never expires)

effective_to.description: When this credential was revoked (null if still active)

block_number.description: Block number when this credential was created

block_hash.description: Block hash when this credential was created

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that created this credential

chain_selector.description: Chain selector where the registry is deployed

block_timestamp.description: Block timestamp when this registry was created

block_number.description: Block number when this registry was created

block_hash.description: Block hash when this registry was created

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that created this registry

DataValidatorEvaluation.description: State of a data validator contract at the time of a policy run evaluation.

version.description: Config version active at the evaluation block

state.description: Decoded data validator configuration active at the evaluation block. Null unless include_policy_details=true or state unavailable.

DataValidatorState.description: Decoded data validator configuration as JSON. Structure varies by validator implementation and is passed through from the coordinator config log.

DefaultBehavior.description: Default behavior when no policy explicitly allows or denies

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g., BAD_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL_ERROR)

request_id.description: Unique request identifier (OTEL trace ID). Include this value when contacting support to help locate the request in logs and traces.

EvmAddress.description: EVM address (0x followed by 40 hex characters)

ExtractorInfo.description: Extractor contract configuration with block metadata

effective_to.description: When this extractor was replaced (null if still active)

block_number.description: Block number when this extractor was set

block_hash.description: Block hash when this extractor was set

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that set this extractor

HexBytes.description: Hex-encoded bytes (0x followed by hex characters)

IdentityAddressInfo.description: A wallet address registered to an identity in a specific registry

effective_from.description: When this address registration became active

effective_to.description: When this address registration was removed (null if still active)

block_number.description: Block number when this registration was created

block_hash.description: Block hash when this registration was created

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that created this registration

IdentityData.description:
Identity representation with nested structure. A CCID (Cross-Chain ID) can be registered
in multiple identity registries (across different chains) and can have multiple wallet
addresses within each registry. Credentials are associated with the CCID itself.

org_id.description: Organization that owns this identity. Present only for admin cross-org queries.

ccid.description: Cross-Chain ID - unique identifier for the identity

registries.description: Identity registries where this CCID is registered (across chains)

credentials.description: Credentials associated with this identity (null if include_credential_details=false)

IdentityListResponse.description: Paginated list of identities. When no identities match the given filters, an empty array is returned with a 200 status (not 404).

next_page_token.description: Opaque token to retrieve the next page of results. Null or absent when there are no more results. Pass this value as the page_token query parameter to fetch the next page.

IdentityRegistryEntry.description: Entry for a CCID within a specific identity registry

chain_selector.description: Chain selector where the registry is deployed

addresses.description: Wallet addresses registered for this CCID in this registry

block_timestamp.description: Block timestamp when this registry was created

block_number.description: Block number when this registry was created

block_hash.description: Block hash when this registry was created

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that created this registry

MapperInfo.description: Mapper contract configuration with block metadata

effective_to.description: When this mapper was replaced (null if still active)

block_number.description: Block number when this mapper was set

block_hash.description: Block hash when this mapper was set

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that set this mapper

MethodPolicy.description:
A policy attached to a protected method.
Note: A policy only appears in this list if it has an active version at the as_of time.
Policies without versions are not included.

policy_name.description: Human-readable policy name (null if not set)

parameter_names.description: Parameter names this policy expects from the extractor (derived from policyParameterNames in contract)

mapper.description: Mapper configuration for this policy (null if not configured)

version.description: Policy version number (as of the requested as_of time)

effective_from.description: When this policy version became active

effective_to.description: When this policy version was superseded (null if current version)

block_number.description: Block number when this policy version was created

block_hash.description: Block hash when this policy version was created

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that created this policy version

MethodSelector.description: 4-byte function selector (0x followed by 8 hex characters)

OnChainPolicyRunData.description: On-chain ACE policy engine evaluation details for a single PolicyRunComplete event

org_id.description: Organization that owns this policy run. Present only for admin cross-org queries.

target_contract_address.description: Target contract address that was evaluated

engine_address.description: Policy engine address that performed the evaluation

policies.description: Policies attached to this selector at evaluation time (null if no policies exist)

params.description: Parameters extracted from the transaction calldata by the extractor

engine_default_behavior.description: Engine-level default behavior at time of evaluation

target_default_behavior.description: Target-level default behavior at time of evaluation (null if unavailable)

extractor_address.description: Extractor contract address active at time of evaluation (null if no extractor set for this selector)

log_index.description: Log index of the evaluation event within the block

PageSize.description: Maximum number of results to return per page (1-100, default 20). The actual number of results may be less than page_size if fewer results remain. When next_page_token is null in the response, there are no more results.

next_page_token.description: Opaque pagination token; absent or null when no more pages.

org_id.description: Organization that owns this policy. Present only for admin cross-org queries.

name.description: Human-readable policy name (null if not set)

version.description: Version number (latest unless as_of is specified)

effective_from.description: When this policy version became active

effective_to.description: When this policy version was superseded (null if current version)

block_number.description: Block number when this version was created

block_hash.description: Block hash when this version was created

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that created this version

PolicyListResponse.description: Paginated list of policies. When no policies match the given filters, an empty array is returned with a 200 status (not 404).

next_page_token.description: Opaque token to retrieve the next page of results. Null or absent when there are no more results. Pass this value as the page_token query parameter to fetch the next page.

PolicyRunCredentialSource.description: A credential source configured on a validator policy at the time of a policy run.

credential_type_id.description: Credential type ID (null when not restricted to a specific type)

data_validator.description: Data validator state at time of evaluation; null when no validator is configured for this source.

PolicyRunMethod.description: Function method information for a policy run

PolicyRunPolicyDetail.description:
Details of a single policy attached to the evaluated selector at the time of the policy run.
Note: per-policy individual result (ALLOWED/DENIED/CONTINUE), denial_reason, and mapped_params
are not available from the on-chain PolicyRunComplete event.

version.description: Policy version active at time of evaluation

name.description: Human-readable policy name (null if not set)

mapper_address.description: Mapper contract address active at time of evaluation (null if not configured)

policy_state.description: Policy state/configuration at time of evaluation (null if include_policy_details=false or unavailable)

credential_sources.description: Credential sources configured on this policy at evaluation time. Present only for CredentialRegistryIdentityValidatorPolicy and GroupedIdentityValidatorPolicy; null for all other policy types. data_validator.state within each source is populated only when include_policy_details=true.

PolicyState.description: Policy state as JSON. Structure varies by policy type and is passed through from the on-chain policy contract. Field names within the state object are determined by the smart contract and may use camelCase (e.g., maxAmount) rather than the snake_case convention used by the rest of this API.

ProtectedMethod.description: A method on the target contract that is protected by policies

extractor.description: Extractor configuration for this selector (null if not configured)

policies.description: Policies attached to this method (order is significant - evaluated in order). Empty array if no policies configured.

RegistryType.description: Registry tenancy type for the registry_address filter

RegistryUsageEvent.description: One proven IDV registry usage from a PolicyRunComplete-backed run. consumer_org_id is omitted.

org_id.description: Organization that owns this registry. Present only for admin cross-org queries.

registry_address.description: Registry address from the request filter (lowercase)

ccid.description: Lowercase hex bytes32 (0x-prefixed); aligns with reporting CCID conventions.

log_index.description: Policy run / PolicyRunComplete log index (disambiguate multiple runs per tx).

matched_policy_address.description: Policy whose policy_versions.state contained the matching credentialSources element.

credential_type_ids.description: Credential type IDs declared on the matched policy credential source(s) for this identity registry / credential registry pair. PolicyRunComplete does not carry the specific credential type that satisfied validation, so all acceptable credential types are listed at the time of the policy run.

next_page_token.description: Opaque pagination token; absent or null when no more pages.

StoredPermit.description: One PermitStored event for metering off-chain workflow permits.

org_id.description: Organization that owns this permit's policy. Present only for admin cross-org queries.

log_index.description: PermitStored log index within the block.

TargetData.description:
Target contract representation. A target is a contract protected by one or more policy engines.
Each target can be attached to multiple policy engines, and each attachment can have
protected methods with associated policies.

org_id.description: Organization that owns this target. Present only for admin cross-org queries.

chain_selector.description: Chain selector where the target is deployed

policy_engines.description: Policy engines this target is attached to

TargetListResponse.description: Paginated list of targets. When no targets match the given filters, an empty array is returned with a 200 status (not 404).

next_page_token.description: Opaque token to retrieve the next page of results. Null or absent when there are no more results. Pass this value as the page_token query parameter to fetch the next page.

TargetPolicyEngineAttachment.description: Information about a target's attachment to a policy engine

attached_at.description: When this target was attached to the policy engine

detached_at.description: When this target was detached (null if still attached)

engine_default_behavior.description: Engine-level default behavior when no policy matches (ALLOW or DENY)

target_default_behavior.description: Target-level default behavior override (null if not configured)

protected_methods.description: Methods protected by policies (null if no methods configured)

block_number.description: Block number when this attachment was created

block_hash.description: Block hash when this attachment was created

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash that created this attachment

TransactionData.description:
On-chain transaction that triggered at least one ACE policy engine
evaluation (PolicyRunComplete event). Every returned transaction is
guaranteed to have one or more policy runs. Policy state detail is
included only when include_policy_details=true.

chain_selector.description: Chain selector where the transaction was executed

block_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the block containing the transaction

to_address.description: Recipient address (null for contract creation transactions)

value.description: Transaction value in wei (as string to avoid precision loss)

gas_limit.description: Gas limit set for the transaction

gas_fee_cap.description: Maximum fee per gas (EIP-1559, as string)

gas_tip_cap.description: Maximum priority fee per gas (EIP-1559, as string)

effective_gas_price.description: Effective gas price in wei (as string)

cumulative_gas_used.description: Cumulative gas used in the block up to this transaction

revert_reason.description: Revert reason if transaction reverted (null if succeeded or not available)

l1_gas_used.description: L1 gas used (for L2 chains, null otherwise)

l1_fee.description: L1 fee in wei (for L2 chains, as string, null otherwise)

policy_runs.description: ACE policy engine evaluations (PolicyRunComplete events) for this transaction

TransactionHash.description: Transaction hash (0x followed by 64 hex characters)

next_page_token.description: Opaque token to retrieve the next page of results. Null or absent when there are no more results. Pass this value as the page_token query parameter to fetch the next page.

TransactionPolicyRunData.description:
A policy engine evaluation for a transaction. Contains nested on-chain evaluation
details. Off-chain evaluation is not yet implemented.

AdminOrgId.name: org_id
AdminOrgId.description: Admin-only filter to scope results to a specific organization. Ignored for tenant requests.
